sections.description: Top-level sections of the installer, in run order.

choice.description: Only one of the packages here can be selected; with required, exactly one. A string is a base name: requiring it (or the implicit requirement of a source, e.g. paru) is met by whichever alternative is chosen.

name.description: Heading. The id is the slugified name (e.g. desktop-hardware).

required.description: Required: always selected and cannot be deselected. Inherited downwards; the closest level wins.

selected.description: Preselected at start but can be deselected. Inherited downwards; the closest level wins.

requires.description: Packages or section ids required by every package in the section.

required.description: Required: always selected and cannot be deselected. Inherited downwards; the closest level wins.

selected.description: Preselected at start but can be deselected. Inherited downwards; the closest level wins.

paru.description: AUR via paru -S --needed --noconfirm <flags> <name>. Requires the package 'paru'.

flatpak.description: flatpak install -y flathub <flags> <app-id>. Requires the package 'flatpak'.

npm.description: sudo npm install -g <flags> <name>. Requires the package 'npm'.

uv.description: uv tool install <flags> <name>. Requires the package 'uv'.

dotnet.description: dotnet tool update -g <flags> <id>. Requires the package 'dotnet'.

script.description: Runs scripts/<name>.sh (or file) with bash -euo pipefail, cwd = the config's directory. Env: CONFIG_PATH (the config's directory), FILES (CONFIG_PATH/files). Runs once (marker file).

oneOf.description: Package name as key, options as value.

flags.description: Extra flags for the install command.

required.description: Required: always selected and cannot be deselected. Inherited downwards; the closest level wins.

selected.description: Preselected at start but can be deselected. Inherited downwards; the closest level wins.

sudo.description: Whether sudo is needed (asks for the password before it runs). Overrides detection from the source and from 'sudo' in the script/post commands.

always.description: Script only: run every time the package is needed, without a marker file.

file.description: Script only: path to the script, relative to the config, absolute or ~/. Defaults to scripts/<name>.sh. flags are passed as arguments.

requires.description: Packages or section ids that must be installed first.
